description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named 'ReadingGoalController' for managing reading goals within a book tracking application. It provides endpoints to add, delete, and retrieve reading goals, including handling HTTP requests and responses. The class interacts with a 'ReadingGoalService' to perform operations related to reading goals.

classes.name: ReadingGoalController
classes.description: Spring REST controller for managing reading goals, including creating, deleting, and retrieving goals through HTTP endpoints.

classes.name: Endpoints
classes.description: Nested static class defining endpoint URL paths for the ReadingGoalController.

methods.name: deleteReadingGoal
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete all reading goals.

methods.name: addBookReadingGoal
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create or update a reading goal based on number of books.

methods.name: addPagesReadingGoal
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create or update a reading goal based on number of pages.

methods.name: getPreviousReadingGoals
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all previous reading goals.

methods.name: getExistingReadingGoal
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the current reading goal, throws 404 if none exists.
